title: Auto Glass Services Tier Scope Schedule: Repair Limits, Glass Features and Open Jobs per Vehicle
content:
This schedule sets, tier by tier, the repair limits, the glass features each tier fits, whether only original-equipment glass may be installed, and how many glass jobs one vehicle may have open at once, for **Auto Glass Services** at Crestline Collision & Glass.

## 1. Definitions of the scheduled terms

1.1 **Chips repaired per job**: most chips repaired on one job (integer; 0 means not applicable).

1.2 **Largest repairable chip**: largest chip diameter that can be repaired (inches, 1 decimal; 0.0 means not applicable).

1.3 **Longest repairable crack**: longest crack that can be repaired (inches, 1 decimal; 0.0 means not applicable).

1.4 **Repair in the driver's view**: whether damage in the driver's critical viewing area may be repaired rather than replaced (boolean).

1.5 **Head-up display glass**: whether the tier fits head-up display glass (boolean).

1.6 **Acoustic interlayer glass**: whether the tier fits acoustic interlayer glass (boolean).

1.7 **Heated glass**: whether the tier fits glass with heating elements (boolean).

1.8 **Original-equipment glass only**: whether only original-equipment glass may be installed (boolean).

1.9 **Open glass jobs per vehicle**: glass jobs one vehicle may have open at once (integer).

## 2. Repair limits

| Tier | Chips repaired per job | Largest repairable chip (in) | Longest repairable crack (in) | Repair in the driver's view |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Windshield Chip Repair | 3 | 1.0 | 6.0 | No |
| Side Glass Replacement | 0 | 0.0 | 0.0 | No |
| Rear Glass Replacement | 0 | 0.0 | 0.0 | No |
| Windshield Replacement | 0 | 0.0 | 0.0 | No |
| Camera-Equipped Windshield Replacement | 0 | 0.0 | 0.0 | No |
| Premium Feature Windshield Replacement | 0 | 0.0 | 0.0 | No |

On the five replacement tiers the figures 0 and 0.0 mean that the repair limit is not applicable to the tier.

## 3. Glass fitment and part type

| Tier | Head-up display glass | Acoustic interlayer glass | Heated glass | Original-equipment glass only |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Windshield Chip Repair | No | No | No | No |
| Side Glass Replacement | No | Yes | No | No |
| Rear Glass Replacement | No | No | Yes | No |
| Windshield Replacement | No | No | No | No |
| Camera-Equipped Windshield Replacement | No | No | No | No |
| Premium Feature Windshield Replacement | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

## 4. Open glass jobs per vehicle

| Tier | Open glass jobs per vehicle |
|---|---|
| Windshield Chip Repair | 1 |
| Side Glass Replacement | 1 |
| Rear Glass Replacement | 1 |
| Windshield Replacement | 1 |
| Camera-Equipped Windshield Replacement | 1 |
| Premium Feature Windshield Replacement | 1 |

## 5. Reading the schedule

- **Which tier carries chip limits?** Only Windshield Chip Repair: up to 3 chips on one job, a chip diameter of up to 1.0 inch and a crack length of up to 6.0 inches.
- **Is damage in the driver's critical viewing area repaired on any tier?** No tier shows "Yes" in that column; repair in the driver's view is not allowed on any of the six tiers.
- **Which tiers fit acoustic interlayer glass?** Side Glass Replacement and Premium Feature Windshield Replacement.
- **Which tiers fit heated glass?** Rear Glass Replacement and Premium Feature Windshield Replacement.
- **Which tier fits head-up display glass?** Premium Feature Windshield Replacement alone, which is also the one tier on which only original-equipment glass may be installed.
- **How many glass jobs may one vehicle have open at once?** 1, on every tier.

*Hypothetical illustration:* a windshield showing two chips, the larger 0.8 inch across, and no crack, all outside the driver's critical viewing area, stays within every limit in the Windshield Chip Repair row (2 is not more than 3 chips; 0.8 is under 1.0 inch).
